text:
Anna - Docs: Heads-up — I opened a "kitchen-sink" PR to tidy up the 429/timeouts/error-ref area. It's a bit of everything: snippet updates, link fixes, lint failures, and one flaky example output. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4822 :eyes:
Mike - Eng: Thanks. Which snippets are changing? I can help with anything runtime-y or that references headers/429 behavior.
Anna - Docs: Mostly SDK retry examples (Python + JS), the sample CLI repro, and the fallback matrix table. Also trimming an overly long context example that currently triggers our own sample 429 in CI.
Sara - SDK: Pinged — I'm on the Python snippet cleanup. One thing: the current sample uses `max_retries=5` without jitter; I'll swap to exponential backoff + jitter and add a short note about idempotency. Suggestion: show both a short client-side backoff and the recommended server-guided Retry-After handling.
Eli - SRE: Quick note — when we mention Retry-After, please be explicit about 429 vs 503 semantics. 429 = rate, can include Retry-After but is advisory. 503 might be overload. Some customers confuse them.
Anna - Docs: Good call, Eli. I'll add a one-liner and a tiny table. Also need someone to sanity-check links — several anchor refs broke after the recent refactor of /runbooks/429.
DocBot: link-checker: 3 broken anchors found in /docs/error-ref/429.md -> /docs/runbooks/429.md#backoff-heuristics, /docs/error-ref/timeouts.md#client-timeouts, /docs/sdk/snippets/python.md#retry-examples
Mike - Eng: I can fix the runtime references to the kernel selection note. But the broken anchors look like doc path changes, not code. I can open a quick patch to rewire the anchors if you want.
Anna - Docs: That would be great. Also the PR includes a tiny code block that used to log entire token payloads — we should redact that to avoid leaking sample data.
Sara - SDK: For the JS snippet, current sample shows `await client.generate({prompt})` in a tight loop. I'll add a debounce example and move to streaming with a warning about CPU-bound clients causing bursts. Also include the recommended header handling: `if (res.status === 429) { const retryAfter = parseInt(res.headers['retry-after'] || '1', 10); await sleep(jittered(retryAfter)); }`
Eli - SRE: Can we also add a short note about circuit-breaking in the Dedicated tier? A single misbehaving client can saturate a pool; recommend token-based rate-limiting on the client side + server fallback to a lower-capacity variant.
Anna - Docs: Yup. I'll draft a 2-sentence blurb under "operational mitigations".
Mike - Eng: Minor: CI lint is failing on one Markdown table cell with newline in code. I'll push a formatting fix to the PR branch.
Anna - Docs: Awesome. Two small asks: 1) please don't squash the history — I want to preserve individual snippet fixes, 2) add a short changelog entry in docs/CHANGELOG.md noting the redaction and anchor fixes.
Sara - SDK: Will do. I'll include the code samples and mention the idempotency caveat.
Eli - SRE: I'll add an internal runbook pointer (SRE-only) in a comment, not published.
Anna - Docs: Final check before merge: anyone want to eyeball the edited examples? I can wait 2 hours for reviews, otherwise I'll merge with @ingress gating.
Mike - Eng: I'll review in ~30m.
Sara - SDK: Reviewing now. Small nit: JS snippet still references legacy `retryDelayMs` param. I'll update to `retry` object with `strategy` key.
Anna - Docs: Thanks. I'm updating the PR description with the list of files changed and rationale. Also added a note about why we redacted the token payload sample.
DocBot: ci-checker: markdown-lint passed. link-checker: re-run shows 0 broken anchors in changed files.
Anna - Docs: Lovely — merging in 15 unless any objections. :shipit:
Mike - Eng: No objections.
Sara - SDK: LGTM.
Eli - SRE: LGTM.
Anna - Docs: Merged. Thanks everyone — I'll open a short follow-up to add a quick sample to the SDK repo that demonstrates jittered backoff with our client wrapper.
